relevantCoverage: Malformed project manifests rejected before cloud record creation
Malformed manifest update does not advance saved revision
Stale cloud save does not overwrite the latest project or add a revision
Loaded revision required before cloud replacement
Concurrent saves accept only one writer for a project revision
limitations: Miniflare/local D1 only; does not verify deployed API routes, Cloudflare bindings, authentication provider credentials, or production data.
